variants.headline: The treasury slips into deficit
body: The nation's accounts have turned negative. Spending now outruns income by {{deficit}} gold a turn, after the books held at or above balance in the recent count.

variants.headline: The treasury's rate, in deficit
body: Rate in the recent count: at or above balance.
Rate now: in deficit.
Shortfall: {{deficit}} gold each turn.

variants.headline: A deficit that names no one
body: Income now trails spending by {{deficit}} gold a turn, where the recent count showed the accounts at or above balance. A shortfall that arrives without a decision attached still repeats every turn, and the ledger does not say who will be asked to make it good.

variants.headline: Sir, the treasury now outspends its income
body: I keep a stall by the east gate, and when I spend more than I earn, my wife hears of it before the market closes. The treasury now spends {{deficit}} gold a turn more than it earns. When does the palace hear of it?

variants.headline: The treasury passes 1,000 gold
body: The reserve has crossed the 1,000 gold mark and now stands at {{gold}}. It took on {{gain}} gold since the recent count.

variants.headline: The reserve passes the thousand mark
body: We are informed that the treasury has lately passed the 1,000 gold mark and now holds {{gold}} gold. A full vault is the mark of a well-kept house, grown by {{gain}} gold in recent turns.

variants.headline: Hear it! A thousand gold in the vault!
body: Hear it, merchants and magistrates! The treasury has passed the 1,000 gold mark and holds {{gold}} gold. A thousand gold, counted and kept!

variants.headline: The treasury just crossed 1,000 gold
body: Reserve: {{gold}} gold, up {{gain}} gold in a few turns. The mark is passed, and the number is exact.

variants.headline: The treasury gains time against the deficit
body: The shortfall continues, but the treasury has more room against it. The reserve of {{gold}} gold now covers {{turnsLeft}} turns at {{deficit}} gold a turn, where the recent count showed shorter cover.

variants.headline: Time returns to the treasury
body: The shortfall holds at {{deficit}} gold a turn, yet the reserve now funds {{turnsLeft}} turns of it on {{gold}} gold. The recent count left less room. A deficit that can be carried this long is a problem with options, and options are what an administration needs.

variants.headline: The count runs long at the money-changer's table
body: A few turns back, the money-changers were counting the treasury's remaining turns on their fingers. This morning the tally ran to {{turnsLeft}} turns of cover, {{gold}} gold against {{deficit}} a turn, and the talk over the coins turned easier.

variants.headline: The treasury reserve runs short
body: The deficit that showed in the recent count continues at {{deficit}} gold a turn, and the reserve behind it is wearing thin. The {{gold}} gold on hand covers {{turnsLeft}} full turns of spending at that rate.

variants.headline: The treasury, counted
body: Reserve: {{gold}} gold.
Shortfall: {{deficit}} gold a turn.
Cover at this rate: {{turnsLeft}} full turns.

variants.headline: Treasury cover down to {{turnsLeft}} turns
body: The treasury holds {{gold}} gold. Spending outruns income by {{deficit}} gold a turn. That leaves {{turnsLeft}} turns of cover, and the shortfall is not new. The figures do not say who is minding the store.

variants.headline: The old rule was a full store
body: Our grandparents kept a reserve against bad years, and bad years came all the same. The treasury now holds {{gold}} gold against a deficit of {{deficit}} gold a turn, {{turnsLeft}} turns from empty. The paper's view is the old one: fill the store before the store empties itself.

variants.headline: The deficit ends
body: The treasury's rate has climbed out of the red. Income now covers spending, leaving {{goldPerTurn}} gold a turn to spare after the recent shortfall.

variants.headline: The state pays its way
body: The treasury's rate stands at {{goldPerTurn}} gold a turn, at or above balance after the recent shortfall. Spending no longer takes more than income brings, and the state is paying its way.

variants.headline: Notice: the accounts no longer run behind
body: We are informed that the deficit lately showing in the accounts has closed. The rate now reads {{goldPerTurn}} gold a turn, and good order in the treasury serves the whole nation.

variants.headline: The purse that stopped leaking
body: They say a stopped leak fills no purse, but it empties none. The treasury's leak has stopped; what comes in now meets what goes out.

variants.headline: Hear it! The treasury runs a surplus!
body: Hear it, good people! Income beats spending by {{goldPerTurn}} gold a turn, and the deficit is done! The lean stretch is past us, past us!
